messages:
Maya Chen: Heads-up — Luminary (midmarket) adoption stalled after initial pilot. Key users dropped off during batch import. Renewal in 32 days. I'm proposing a short 'wake-up workflow' to try and recover engagement. Open to input.

Darren O'Neill: Ugh. Do we have the funnel numbers? Which step exactly?

Sofia Alvarez: From the onboarding dashboard: 62% completed onboarding tasks, but only 18% hit week-2 active usage. Drop concentrated at 'bulk import -> vectorize' step.

Nikhil Rao: Telemetry: throughput ok, but there are intermittent 400s during multi-file uploads for customers hitting >10MB payloads. Also a spike in token costs because some jobs retried.

Maya Chen: Proposed quick workflow: 1) Rapid triage call (15m) with PM + ops 2) One-click temporary config change to reduce batch concurrency for them 3) Short enablement demo focused on import best-practices + caching 4) Follow-up check in 5 days 5) Escalation to renewal team if no improvement. Owner: @Sofia.

Darren O'Neill: Add a clear downgrade-consequence note: if they request seat reduction, offer a bridge plan that preserves model versioning and audit logs but reduces throughput. Keep rollback path documented.

Sofia Alvarez: I'll run the triage script and collect their onboarding answers prior to the call. Also will ask if they used prefix caching and whether they batched vs streaming.

Nikhil Rao: Quick mitigation I can push immediately: limit upload concurrency to 3 and cap file size to 8MB for Luminary org ID. Config patch: ```{"org":"luminary","max_concurrency":3,"max_file_mb":8,"fallback_route":"dedicated-small"}``` will reduce retries.

Maya Chen: Outreach copy for the triage invite (short): "Hi {{name}}, we noticed import failures and low activity. Can we do a 15-min triage to run one quick config change and demo import tips? Available tomorrow 10:30am PT?"

Darren O'Neill: Good. I'll prep a one-page summary for the renewals rep with bullets: why we intervened, what we changed, rollback terms, success criteria (import success rate >90%, weekly active users +25% in 7 days).

ops-bot: Created ticket CS-8729 for Luminary activation rescue. Priority: Medium. Owner: Nikhil Rao.

Sofia Alvarez: Post-triage plan: capture two screenshots of pre/post import success, add a short note on playbook page (tag: activation-rescue-slim). Also request short feedback from their PM on session usefulness.

Nikhil Rao: Pushed concurrency cap to staging. Running smoke tests now. Will post results.

Maya Chen: Timeline: triage call by EOD tomorrow, staging patch verified same day, prod change within 6 hours after call if needed, follow-up check in 5 days, renewals update 7 days before renewal.

Darren O'Neill: If they still want to reduce spend we can propose rate-limited reserved plan instead of immediate downgrade — keeps them on same infra but reduces throughput. Make it time-limited (30 days).

Sofia Alvarez: On the call we'll also demo prefix caching and small-file streaming which usually reduces retries significantly.

Nikhil Rao: Smoke test passed in staging. No errors for 50 simulated imports at the new caps. Ready to deploy post-call.

Maya Chen: Thanks team. If this works we'll formalize the wake-up workflow and add checklist + config snippets to the CS play library. Please paste meeting notes and logs here after the session.

Darren O'Neill: Copy. I'll draft the renewal note and add to Gainsight once we have post-change metrics.

Sofia Alvarez: Meeting scheduled for tomorrow 10:30am PT. Adding meeting notes template to thread.

Maya Chen: Great — let's go get them back on track :raised_hands:
